### Calculate mean mortality rate per district per tx level in Randomization 1.

```{r}

district_means_all <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::select(district, deaths_per_1000_1to59) %>%
  mutate(district = ifelse(district=="Tibiri (Doutchi)","Tibiri",district)) %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(mean_deaths_per_1000_all = mean(deaths_per_1000_1to59, na.rm=T))

district_means_tx0 <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTreated_child=="Control") %>%
  dplyr::select(district, deaths_per_1000_1to59) %>%
  mutate(district = ifelse(district=="Tibiri (Doutchi)","Tibiri",district)) %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(mean_deaths_per_1000_tx0 = mean(deaths_per_1000_1to59, na.rm=T))

district_means_tx1 <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(isTreated_child=="Treatment") %>%
  dplyr::select(district, deaths_per_1000_1to59) %>%
  mutate(district = ifelse(district=="Tibiri (Doutchi)","Tibiri",district)) %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(mean_deaths_per_1000_tx1 = mean(deaths_per_1000_1to59, na.rm=T))

district_means <- district_means_tx0 %>%
  left_join(district_means_tx1, join_by(district)) %>%
  left_join(district_means_all, join_by(district)) %>%
  mutate(mean_ATE = mean_deaths_per_1000_tx1 - mean_deaths_per_1000_tx0)

district_means_tx0; district_means_tx1; district_means

```

### Map mean mortality rate per district per tx level.
#### Merge data with shp data.
```{r}

df_map_dist_means <- niger_adm2 %>%
  left_join(district_means, 
            join_by(adm_02 == district))

df_map_dist_means %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso")

```

#### Create ggplots.
```{r}
min_mort_d = 0
max_mort_d = 35

min_d_ATE = -7
max_d_ATE = 2


map_district_means_all <- 
  ggplot(df_map_dist_means %>% filter(adm_01 == "Dosso")) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_deaths_per_1000_all)) +
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),fill=NA,color="white") +      #boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",title="A") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1,
                     limits = c(min_mort_d,max_mort_d),
                     na.value = NA,
                     breaks = seq(min_mort_d,max_mort_d,5),
                     guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          direction="horizontal",
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white") )


map_district_means_tx0 <- 
  ggplot(df_map_dist_means %>% filter(adm_01 == "Dosso")) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_deaths_per_1000_tx0)) +
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),fill=NA,color="white") +      #boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",title="A") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1,
                     limits = c(min_mort_d,max_mort_d),
                     na.value = NA,
                     breaks = seq(min_mort_d,max_mort_d,5),
                     guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          direction="horizontal",
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white") )

map_district_means_tx1 <- 
  ggplot(df_map_dist_means %>% filter(adm_01 == "Dosso")) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_deaths_per_1000_tx1)) +
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),fill=NA,color="white") + #boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",title="B") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1,
                     limits = c(min_mort_d,max_mort_d),
                     na.value = NA,
                     breaks = seq(min_mort_d,max_mort_d,5),
                     guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          direction="horizontal",
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white") )

map_district_means_ate <- 
  ggplot(df_map_dist_means %>% filter(adm_01 == "Dosso")) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_ATE)) +
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2 %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),fill=NA,color="white") + #boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",title="D") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face="bold",size=16),
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
      scale_fill_gradient2(name="ATE: difference in mortality per 1000 person-years",
                           midpoint=0,
                           low = muted("dodgerblue"),
                           mid = "white",
                           high = muted("red"),
                           limits = c(min_d_ATE,max_d_ATE),
                           breaks = seq(min_d_ATE,max_d_ATE,1),
                           labels = as.character(seq(min_d_ATE,max_d_ATE,1)),
                           na.value = NA,
                           guide=guide_colorbar(
                             title="ATE: difference in mortality per 1000 person-years", 
                                                title.position = "top",
                                                title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                direction="horizontal",
                                                label.position = "bottom",
                                                label.hjust = 0.5,
                                                barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                                barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                                ticks.colour = "white",
                                                ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                                frame.colour = "white",
                                                draw.llim = T,
                                                draw.ulim = T))

map_district_means_all; map_district_means_tx0; map_district_means_tx1; map_district_means_ate

```

### Save ggplots.
```{r}

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/aggregate-district-panels/avenir-district-mean-ATE-",
                         Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_district_means_tx0 + 
         map_district_means_tx1 + 
         map_district_means_ate,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 400,

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/aggregate-district-panels/avenir-district-mean-ATE-",
```
